description: Topic-driven X discovery subsystem (Part B) on its own 6h schedule, fully separate from the main 30-60min workflow. Adds config/xDiscovery.ts, four injectable gateways (discovered_accounts, x_scrape_health, x_daily_budget, saved_x_posts) each as interface + libSQL impl + in-memory stub, pure learning math, the xQueryAgent + queryGen, the runDiscovery orchestrator (stamps per-account medians + isOfficialAccount + accountStatus at SAVE time per FIX #2/#3), the runXDiscovery cron, and the rewrite of collectXPosts to READ saved posts only behind the single X_DISCOVERY_ENABLED feed-only switch (FIX #5/#9). Registers xQueryAgent in src/mastra/index.ts. Depends on FEAT-001 (postToRaw opts, searchXPosts, resolveOutboundUrls, scrape.py search). Independent of FEAT-003 except that collectXPosts' new result shape is consumed by FEAT-004's wiring.
steps: src/mastra/config/xDiscovery.ts — define XDiscoveryConfig + getXDiscoveryConfig() with envNum/envFlag helpers mirroring config/xAccounts.ts, conservative defaults: enabled (X_DISCOVERY_ENABLED, default true), topics (default 'AI','startups','deeptech','AI India','Indian startups','India deeptech'), queriesPerTopic 2, maxTopicsPerSession 3, maxQueriesPerTopic 2, maxScrollsPerQuery 2, hardPostCapPerSession 40, topMinPosts 8, maxSearchLoadsPerDay 30, maxProfileVisitsPerDay 20, dayBoundaryTz 'Asia/Kolkata', actionDelayMsRange [4000,12000], queryDelayMsRange [30000,90000], startJitterPct 0.20, queryCooldownHours 4, stopCooldownHoursLadder [12,24,48], consecutiveEmptyLimit 2, promoteMinTimesSeen 3, promoteMinMedianLikes 200, promoteMinCredibility 6, demoteSpamCredibilityBelow 2, officialMinCredibility 8 (FIX #13), profilePerVisitLimit 20, blocklistHandles [], pinnedHandles [], intervalHours 6, savedPostMaxAgeHours 24, showMoreWaitMs 800, threadCap 5.

src/mastra/lib/x-discovery/stores/discoveredAccounts.ts — DiscoveredAccount (id = handle.toLowerCase(), handle, firstSeen, timesSeen, medianLikes, medianReposts, credibilityScore 0-10, status 'candidate'|'promoted'|'demoted', recentLikes/recentReposts/recentTexts rolling samples cap ~20, lastProfileVisitDay?). DiscoveredAccountsGateway { get, upsertFromScrape(handle, samples, now), list, markProfileVisited(handle, day) } + libSQL impl via createLibSqlRepository<DiscoveredAccount>('discovered_accounts') + createDiscoveredAccountsStubGateway(seed?). upsertFromScrape is where learning happens (code): increment timesSeen, append capped samples, recompute medians + credibilityScore/status via the pure functions in learning.ts; a handle is written ONLY here, from a real scrape result (NFR-2 — the LLM never invents a handle).

src/mastra/lib/x-discovery/stores/xScrapeHealth.ts — XScrapeHealth (id 'health', lastRunAt?, lastStopReason?, cooldownUntil?, cooldownLadderIndex, consecutiveEmpty, lastQueryRunAt: Record<query,ISO>). XScrapeHealthGateway { load, save } + libSQL impl + stub. Escalating cooldown: on a stop condition cooldownUntil = now + ladder[min(index, len-1)], increment index; a clean run with posts resets index and consecutiveEmpty to 0; consecutiveEmpty increments on empty results, triggers a stop at consecutiveEmptyLimit.

src/mastra/lib/x-discovery/stores/xBudget.ts — XDailyBudget (id = YYYY-MM-DD in dayBoundaryTz, searchLoads, profileVisits). XBudgetGateway { today(day), incSearch(day, n?), incProfile(day, n?) } + libSQL impl + stub. Counters key on the day string so they reset at the boundary and survive restarts.

src/mastra/lib/x-discovery/stores/savedXPosts.ts — SavedXPostsGateway { saveMany(items: RawContent[]), recentWithin(maxAgeHours, now): Promise<RawContent[]> } + libSQL impl via createLibSqlRepository('saved_x_posts') (row id = hashString(url), import hashString from collectors/types) + createSavedXPostsStubGateway(seed?). FIX #7: recentWithin filters on each item's publishedAt, falling back to collectedAt, dropping items older than now - maxAgeHours — this is a store-window filter ONLY, NOT the 24h drop (the ranker's too_old owns that). Dedupe by URL at save (row id).

src/mastra/lib/x-discovery/learning.ts — pure, unit-testable: median(nums); credibilityOf(account, config) 0-10 blending saturating timesSeen, median engagement relative to promoteMinMedianLikes, and a spam penalty from recentTexts via /giveaway|airdrop|follow.{0,10}retweet|RT to win|link in bio/i; statusFor(account, config) (promoted when timesSeen>=promoteMinTimesSeen && medianLikes>=promoteMinMedianLikes && credibilityScore>=promoteMinCredibility; demoted when credibilityScore<demoteSpamCredibilityBelow; else candidate); FIX #2/#13 isOfficialAccount(account, config) = (status==='promoted' && credibilityScore>=officialMinCredibility) OR handle in config.pinnedHandles.

src/mastra/agents/xQueryAgent.ts — a small Agent (Agent from @mastra/core/agent) using resolveSmallChatModel() (config/model), no new provider, mirroring agents/rankScoringAgent.ts construction. VERIFY the Agent constructor signature against node_modules/@mastra/core docs/source before writing.

src/mastra/lib/x-discovery/queryGen.ts — QueryGenerate type; generateQueries(topics, opts: { generate?; config?; log? }): Promise<Map<topic,string[]>>. Default generator uses xQueryAgent and asks for plain JSON; validate per topic with z.object({ queries: z.array(z.string()).length(config.queriesPerTopic) }) via extractJson (lib/json-extract) + safeParse + retry-once (mirror llmScore.ts). NFR-2 guards in CODE: strip any @handle/from: tokens from each returned string; force the engagement filter template '(topic) min_faves:300 filter:links -filter:replies lang:en' (append filters if missing); on validation failure after retry fall back to that deterministic template per topic.

src/mastra/lib/x-discovery/runDiscovery.ts — runDiscovery(deps: { config?; generateQueries?; search?; scrapeProfile?; accounts; health; budget; savedPosts; now?; sleep?; rng?; log? }): Promise<DiscoveryReport>. Every step fail-soft (any throw caught -> aborted-but-clean report). Flow: gate on enabled/cooldown(cooldownUntil>now)/budget-exhausted (skip+log); start jitter and per-action/per-query pacing via injected sleep+rng from the configured ranges; generateQueries(topics.slice(0,maxTopicsPerSession)) with code enforcing <=queriesPerTopic and handle-stripping; per query SEQUENTIAL one-tab: skip within queryCooldownHours, skip when searchLoads budget exhausted, search({query,tab:'top',maxScrolls,limit}) + budget.incSearch, on a block stopReason ABORT the whole X branch (set escalating cooldown, break, return aborted:true+stopReason), if count<topMinPosts do a secondary tab:'latest' pass + incSearch, track consecutiveEmpty (abort+cooldown at the limit), accumulate+dedupe by URL, stop at hardPostCapPerSession, sleep a query-delay, record lastQueryRunAt[query]; learn: group accumulated posts by author_handle, skip blocklistHandles, accounts.upsertFromScrape(handle, samples, now); profile pass: for each promoted account plus pinnedHandles not visited today and within maxProfileVisitsPerDay, scrapeProfile({handle, limit: profilePerVisitLimit, maxScrolls}), budget.incProfile, accounts.markProfileVisited, merge posts, blocklist excluded; FIX #2/#3 map+save: for each collected post look up its author's freshly-upserted DiscoveredAccount, compute isOfficialAccount(acct, config) ONCE here, call postToRaw(handle, post, { accountMedianLikes: acct.medianLikes, accountMedianReposts: acct.medianReposts, accountStatus: acct.status, isOfficialAccount, accountCredibilityScore: acct.credibilityScore }), stamp collectedAt = now, savedPosts.saveMany (URL-dedupe); health: clean run resets ladder/empty, persist lastRunAt; return DiscoveryReport { queries, postsScraped, accountsTouched, promoted, aborted, stopReason, budgetUsed, truncatedCount, blocked }.

src/mastra/lib/collect-x-posts.ts — FIX #5/#9: rewrite collectXPosts. New CollectXResult { items: RawContent[]; perAccount: Array<{handle;count;error?}> } (REMOVE sessionNotReady). New signature collectXPosts(opts?: { savedPosts?: SavedXPostsGateway; now?: Date; maxAgeHours?: number; config?: XDiscoveryConfig; log? }). Body: const config = opts?.config ?? getXDiscoveryConfig(); if (!config.enabled) { log('x.disabled',{}); return { items: [], perAccount: [] }; } else read savedPosts.recentWithin(maxAgeHours ?? config.savedPostMaxAgeHours, now); fail-soft to { items: [], perAccount: [] } on any gateway error. REMOVE the scrapeXPosts/checkXSession/getXWatchConfig imports from this module (keep postToRaw + resolveOutboundUrls). This is the structural feed-only guarantee: no scraper reference remains in the main workflow's import graph; the single switch is X_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=false.

src/mastra/cron/runXDiscovery.ts — mirror cron/runAutoNewsRadar.ts (daemon + --once + --demo, loadEnvFile, in-process overlap guard). Build the REAL libSQL gateways + real searchXPosts/scrapeXPosts + real generateQueries; compute next fire as intervalHours +/- startJitterPct; call runDiscovery. --demo injects stubs + a mock search for an offline smoke run. The cron saves results to storage; it never publishes.
package.json — add scripts x:discover, x:discover:once, x:discover:demo (npx -y tsx --env-file=.env src/mastra/cron/runXDiscovery.ts [--once|--demo --once]).
src/mastra/index.ts — register the new xQueryAgent under `agents` (AGENTS.md). Do NOT remove or reorder existing registrations.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` passes with the new config, four gateways, learning, queryGen, xQueryAgent, runDiscovery, the rewritten collectXPosts (no sessionNotReady), and xQueryAgent registered in index.ts.
`npm run x:discover:demo` runs fully OFFLINE (injected stubs + mock search) and prints a DiscoveryReport without making any network call.

collectXPosts returns { items: [], perAccount: [] } without touching the store when X_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=false, and reads savedPosts.recentWithin otherwise; a gateway error yields { items: [], perAccount: [] } (fail-soft).
`npm run test` still passes (existing suites unaffected; FEAT-004 adds the X-specific tests).
findings:
DONE. Verified: `npm run typecheck` exit 0; `npm run x:discover:demo` runs fully OFFLINE (stub gateways + canned mock search + forced deterministic query fallback, no network) and prints a DiscoveryReport (queries=3 posts=12 accounts=2); `npm run test` 87/87 pass (existing suites unaffected).

== config/xDiscovery.ts ==
export interface XDiscoveryConfig; export function getXDiscoveryConfig(): XDiscoveryConfig. Env helpers envFlag/envNum/envStr/parseList/parseTopics/envRange/envLadder (module-private). Switch X_DISCOVERY_ENABLED (default true). All tunables env-overridable (X_DISCOVERY_* prefix), conservative defaults as specified (queriesPerTopic 2, maxTopicsPerSession 3, maxQueriesPerTopic 2, maxScrollsPerQuery 2, hardPostCapPerSession 40, topMinPosts 8, maxSearchLoadsPerDay 30, maxProfileVisitsPerDay 20, dayBoundaryTz 'Asia/Kolkata', actionDelayMsRange [4000,12000], queryDelayMsRange [30000,90000], startJitterPct 0.2, queryCooldownHours 4, stopCooldownHoursLadder [12,24,48], consecutiveEmptyLimit 2, promoteMinTimesSeen 3, promoteMinMedianLikes 200, promoteMinCredibility 6, demoteSpamCredibilityBelow 2, officialMinCredibility 8, profilePerVisitLimit 20, intervalHours 6, savedPostMaxAgeHours 24, showMoreWaitMs 800, threadCap 5). Default topics: AI, startups, deeptech, AI India, Indian startups, India deeptech.

== Gateways (all in src/mastra/lib/x-discovery/stores/, each = interface + libSQL factory + stub factory) ==
discoveredAccounts.ts: interface DiscoveredAccountsGateway { get(handle), upsertFromScrape(handle, samples: AccountSample[], now): DiscoveredAccount, list(), markProfileVisited(handle, day) }. Types: DiscoveredAccountStatus='candidate'|'promoted'|'demoted'; DiscoveredAccount { id=handle.toLowerCase(), handle, firstSeen, timesSeen, medianLikes, medianReposts, credibilityScore, status, recentLikes[], recentReposts[], recentTexts[], lastProfileVisitDay? }; AccountSample { likes?, reposts?, text? }. Factories: createLibSqlDiscoveredAccountsGateway(config?) (alias libSqlDiscoveredAccountsGateway); createDiscoveredAccountsStubGateway(seed?, config?). upsertFromScrape is where learning happens (timesSeen++, capped rolling samples ~20, recompute medians + credibilityOf + statusFor). libSQL table 'discovered_accounts'.
xScrapeHealth.ts: HEALTH_ID='health'; interface XScrapeHealth { id, lastRunAt?, lastStopReason?, cooldownUntil?, cooldownLadderIndex, consecutiveEmpty, lastQueryRunAt: Record<string,string> }; interface XScrapeHealthGateway { load(): XScrapeHealth, save(h) }. Factories: createLibSqlXScrapeHealthGateway() (alias libSqlXScrapeHealthGateway); createXScrapeHealthStubGateway(seed?). Helper freshHealth(). Table 'x_scrape_health'.
xBudget.ts: interface XDailyBudget { id=YYYY-MM-DD, searchLoads, profileVisits }; interface XBudgetGateway { today(day): XDailyBudget, incSearch(day,n?): XDailyBudget, incProfile(day,n?): XDailyBudget }. Exported helper dayKey(now, tz) -> YYYY-MM-DD in tz (en-CA Intl). Factories: createLibSqlXBudgetGateway() (alias libSqlXBudgetGateway); createXBudgetStubGateway(seed?). Table 'x_daily_budget'.
savedXPosts.ts: interface SavedXPostsGateway { saveMany(items: RawContent[]): Promise<void>, recentWithin(maxAgeHours, now): Promise<RawContent[]> }. Row id = hashString(url) (URL dedupe). recentWithin filters publishedAt->collectedAt within window (undated rows kept; this is NOT the ranker's 24h drop). Factories: createLibSqlSavedXPostsGateway() (alias libSqlSavedXPostsGateway); createSavedXPostsStubGateway(seed?). Table 'saved_x_posts'.

== learning.ts (pure) ==
export median(nums), credibilityOf(account, config) 0-10 (saturating timesSeen + median engagement vs promoteMinMedianLikes + repost signal, minus up to -6 spam penalty from recentTexts via /giveaway|airdrop|follow.{0,10}retweet|RT to win|link in bio/i), statusFor(account, config), isOfficialAccount(account, config) (promoted && credibility>=officialMinCredibility OR handle in pinnedHandles).

== agents/xQueryAgent.ts ==
export const xQueryAgent = new Agent({ id:'x-query-agent', name, description, instructions, model }) via resolveSmallChatModel()/RANK_MODEL_* (verified Agent ctor against installed rankScoringAgent @mastra/core 1.67.0). Keyword phrases only; never handles/operators/scores. Registered in src/mastra/index.ts under agents.

== queryGen.ts ==
export type QueryGenerate=(prompt)=>Promise<{text}>; export generateQueries(topics, opts:{generate?,config?,log?}): Promise<Map<topic,string[]>>; export deterministicQuery(topic). Validates z.object({queries:z.array(string).length(queriesPerTopic)}) via extractJson+safeParse+retry-once; CODE strips @handle/from: tokens and forces template '<kw> min_faves:300 filter:links -filter:replies lang:en'; fallback to deterministic template on failure.

== runDiscovery.ts ==
export runDiscovery(deps: RunDiscoveryDeps): Promise<DiscoveryReport>. RunDiscoveryDeps { config?, generateQueries?, search?: XSearchFn, scrapeProfile?: XScrapeProfileFn, accounts, health, budget, savedPosts, now?, sleep?, rng?, log? }. XSearchFn=(opts:{query,tab:'top'|'latest',maxScrolls,limit})=>Promise<XSearchResult>; XScrapeProfileFn=(opts:{handle,limit,maxScrolls})=>Promise<XScrapeResult>.
DiscoveryReport { queries: string[], postsScraped: number (count actually saved), accountsTouched: number, promoted: string[], aborted: boolean, stopReason?: string, budgetUsed:{searchLoads,profileVisits}, truncatedCount: number, blocked: boolean }. Fully fail-soft (top-level try/catch -> aborted emptyReport{stopReason:'error'}). Gates: disabled/cooldown/budget_exhausted. Stamps postToRaw opts (accountMedianLikes/Reposts, accountStatus, isOfficialAccount computed once per author, accountCredibilityScore) + collectedAt=now at SAVE time (FIX #2/#3). Block in profile pass detected via scrapeXPosts result error==='blocked' (XScrapeResult has no stopReason field). Escalating cooldown on block/empty via stopCooldownHoursLadder; clean run w/ posts resets ladder+empties.

== collect-x-posts.ts REWRITE (FIX #5/#9) ==
CollectXResult { items: RawContent[]; perAccount: Array<{handle;count;error?}> }  (sessionNotReady REMOVED). New signature: collectXPosts(opts?:{ savedPosts?: SavedXPostsGateway; now?: Date; maxAgeHours?: number; config?: XDiscoveryConfig; log? }): Promise<CollectXResult>. When !config.enabled -> logs 'x.disabled' and returns {items:[],perAccount:[]} WITHOUT touching the store; else reads savedPosts.recentWithin(maxAgeHours ?? savedPostMaxAgeHours, now); any gateway error -> {items:[],perAccount:[]} (fail-soft). perAccount groups by metadata.authorHandle. SCRAPER IMPORTS REMOVED (no scrapeXPosts/checkXSession/getXWatchConfig); postToRaw + PostToRawOpts + resolveOutboundUrls kept and still exported. This is the structural feed-only guarantee: no scraper in the main workflow import graph.
Caller fix (minimal, required for typecheck): src/mastra/lib/workflow/autoNewsToRas.ts now calls collectXPosts({log, now}) and dropped the sessionNotReady log field.

== cron/runXDiscovery.ts ==
Mirrors runAutoNewsRadar.ts (loadEnvFile, --once, --demo, in-process overlap guard, jittered next-fire = intervalHours +/- startJitterPct). REAL deps: libSQL gateways + lazily-imported searchXPosts/scrapeXPosts (so --demo never pulls the scraper into the graph) + generateQueries. --demo: stub gateways + canned offline mock search + forced-deterministic generateQueries + sleep no-op + rng 0.5. Saves to storage, never publishes.

x:discover, x:discover:once, x:discover:demo (tsx --env-file=.env src/mastra/cron/runXDiscovery.ts [--once | --demo --once]).

NOTE for FEAT-004/005: consume collectXPosts' new CollectXResult {items,perAccount} (no sessionNotReady). DiscoveryReport shape above. X-specific tests are FEAT-004's scope (none added here; new test files must be added to package.json 'test' list to run).
